0022600132.text: The Miami Heat (0-4, on a four-game losing streak) are 15th in the East and 5th in the Southeast as they play their fifth game of the season, while the Atlanta Hawks (2-1, 2nd in the Southeast) are 0.5 games behind the division lead. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot, fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Miami won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 143-117 win in Miami on April 12, 2026.
